comments.body: One of the best places to grind wares trading using PO2 is Davao City in South-East Asia. You can buy 4 sorts of wares there - Mercury, Bronze, Graphite and Lumber.

comments.author: Hadea
comments.body:
I think it's worth saying that Davao also has 2 luxuries, which also use PO2. Money trader favors both luxuries and wares trading.
English players can also grind wares trading in London - 4 kinds of wares and 2 alcohol. Artisan job favors both wares and alcohol trading.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
There was a +2 Wares Trading, +1 Accounts "Wealthy Man's Hat" released earlier this year.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Mediterranean_Sea_Mystery_Bottle

Also, there's the Fidelity Hat which is +2 Accounts, +1 Wares, and is obtained through something to do with Holy Roman Emperor election combos. They're much more common, I'd expect.

Don't recall any others, but I may just have forgotten or overlooked something. The fact is that this is one of the harder skills to find boost equipment for, I'm afraid.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: There's also the Montsuki Haori & Hakama outfit that WhiteBird above mentioned, but that was only obtainable from the astros shop for a very limited time a couple years back (though it has came out 2-3 times as a drop in sailors bottle ablet a very rare drop from what I was told).
